messages:
Sarah (Sales): Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp wants a POC next week. Requirements: tenant-sticky routing to EU only, BYO-KMS, and a failover path to a cheaper global model. Need estimated delta in monthly pricing and a short ops checklist. Can we do this without a full Dedicated contract?
Olivia (Solutions Eng): @Sarah can you confirm whether they need geo-failover within EU (e.g., eu-west -> eu-central) or full cross-region to APAC/US as fallback?
Sarah (Sales): EU-primary, failover allowed to 'global-hosted' (not APAC). Customer cares about latency but more about legal residency for primary traffic.
Ben (Infra): Short answer: we can pin tenant traffic to an EU-only pool (Dedicated or reserved virtual pool). BYO-KMS is supported for Private and Dedicated; hosted BYO-KMS needs entitlements. Pricing delta depends on reserved commit vs burst.
Mike (Network): For tenant-sticky routing we need an affinity key in the routing table (tenant_id -> pool). If the pool is eu-only we must ensure no egress to non-EU sub-processors. Which subprocessor list did legal sign off on?
Sarah (Sales): Legal asked for SP list and certs. They want to confirm no unexpected egress to third-party analytics in US.
Olivia (Solutions Eng): We'll need to create a POC config: routing rule + KMS integration checklist + failover policy. Example routing snippet: ```routing: - match: tenant.region == "eu" route: eu-dedicated-pool fallback: global-hosted model: compatible-quantized```
Ben (Infra): Ops checklist (high level): 1) Provision EU pool (gpu-q8) 2) Attach customer KMS key (BYO) 3) Apply IP allowlist for AcmeCorp 4) Tag requests for billing 5) Enable KV-prefix caching for warmup
Sarah (Sales): Customer asked for a ballpark of monthly cost delta vs standard hosted. Can you throw a quick range? Even high-level % premium is fine for sales deck.
Ben (Infra): If they want reserved capacity: expect ~3-6x per-token unit cost vs shared hosted depending on commit length. If small reserved commit + burst, maybe 1.5-2x. I'll give a narrower estimate after I know expected RPS.
Olivia (Solutions Eng): Also note model choice matters — a quantized 13B on eu-dedicated will be cheaper than an FP16 70B fallback. We should propose: primary = 13B quantized in EU, fallback = 7B hosted global to keep costs down.
Mike (Network): Network ops needs to know certificate chain for BYO-KMS endpoints and whether the KMS is inside customer VPC. If BYO-KMS is external, we need IP allowlist & outbound TLS.
Sarah (Sales): They said BYO-KMS is in their cloud account (customer-managed). They want us to validate we don't hold plaintext keys.
Ben (Infra): We don't store plaintext keys. Integration pattern: we store KMS arn/endpoint + access policy; encryption operations are proxied. I'll draft a short security note.
Olivia (Solutions Eng): Action items: - @Ben produce a 1‑page cost range and provisioning steps by EOD tomorrow - @Mike confirm network certificate and egress constraints - @Sarah confirm expected RPS and any SLAs they want for the POC
Sarah (Sales): I'll get RPS and a short list of legal questions (subprocessors, retention, logs) by EOD.
deploy-bot: Deployment job queued for eu-dedicated-demo at 2023-11-07T14:10:12Z — started provisioning resources.
Ben (Infra): Quick note: if customer insists on zero-subprocessor-except-specified, we need to map all dependent services (monitoring, error reporting). That can add ~2 weeks to the POC timeline.
Olivia (Solutions Eng): For the POC proposal doc I'll include two paths: Minimal POC (hosted fallback, short reserved commit) vs Compliant POC (full private/dedicated + KMS + attestation). Different cost buckets and timelines.
Sarah (Sales): Perfect. Also need a one-liner for execs: "POC can enforce EU-primary residency; BYO-KMS supported; failover allowed to global-hosted with reduced guarantees. Estimated cost premium: 1.5–6x depending on commit and model choices."
Ben (Infra): I'll refine the numbers after RPS.
Mike (Network): If anyone wants me to run a quick traceroute test when we provision, ping me and I'll do it from our eu edge.
Sarah (Sales): Thanks all — will reconvene after I get RPS and legal Qs. :thumbsup:
Olivia (Solutions Eng): Adding note: please include any compliance docs they require (SOC2/ISO certs list) so we can attach to the quote.
Ben (Infra): A couple more small asks from security: 1) retention for logs for POC (default 30 days) 2) whether request logs include full prompt (they might want redaction).
Sarah (Sales): I'll surface both. Closing loop — will post customer answers in this thread. :eyes:
